# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault

        (body ++ borderEls)

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"
